notes.title: We're Still Here – Working on Comic-Style Sound Effects
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Don’t worry — we’re still alive!

Progress takes a bit longer with our tiny team and limited time, but we’re hard at work behind the scenes.

Right now, we’re focused on adding [b]comic-style text effects[/b] — on-screen captions like “PEW PEW” and “BOOM” that appear the moment an impact happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213119/56ee3e6994b75ef646813cae25868e35d8bbc72f.gif[/img]

These sound words — also known as onomatopoeia — will pop up for everything from massive explosions down to dripping pipes. We're currently in the experimentation phase, looking for ways to make the game feel even more lively and expressive.

If you enjoy early dev previews or might be interested in testing the game later, feel free to join our [b]Discord[/b] — we’ll post updates there too.

Thanks for sticking with us — more updates will follow as we get closer to release!

— The Situation Normal Team

notes.title: Full Menu Overhaul: A Retro Arcade Makeover!
notes.notes:
[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213119/0ff1c540f69d9a433a52cb90f8bd51cb70e5e20c.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Retro Arcade Design: The entire menu has been redesigned with a nostalgic, classic arcade style that feels fresh and exciting.
[*] Centered Menu Entries: All menu options are now perfectly centered below the title, making navigation smoother and more visually appealing.
[*] New Color Theme: The updated color scheme of red, yellow, and a touch of light blue.
[/list]

This update is all about improving how you interact with the game from the moment you launch it. We can’t wait for you to dive into the new and improved menu of Situation Normal! Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Steam Deck Ready!
notes.notes:
We’ve got exciting news for you: Situation Normal is fully Steam Deck compliant, delivering a seamless and thrilling gaming experience on the go. Whether you're dodging explosions or uncovering Dr. Hibble's secrets, everything runs smoothly on your Steam Deck.

Want to try it out? [url=https://discord.com/invite/k3ADCrE838]Join our Discord[/url] and grab one of the 2 remaining playtest slots for the year. Don’t wait!

notes.title: Recruiting Playtesters for Operation: SNAFU!
notes.notes:
We’ve got some exciting news: we're opening up 3 slots for playtesters to test the demo of our upcoming action-packed platformer, Situation Normal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213119/a8d39b012c32cfdab68dcf76678125797e034119.gif[/img]

Want in? Join our Discord at https://discord.gg/zquVBgSM5Y and request the playtester role. We’ll review all applications and, if you qualify, you'll receive a Steam key to try out the demo.

Get ready to experience the chaos firsthand—don’t miss this chance to be one of the first to dive in!

notes.title: New Explosive Ideas
notes.notes:
We're introducing exciting new mechanics to boost your in-game experience. Not only can you dash with recoil, but now explosions generate shockwaves, shoving you through rooms and obstacles. Prepare for a thrilling challenge as knockback forces from both guns and bombs give you new, creative ways to navigate and conquer each level!

[previewyoutube=u_JKzSdhG7o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bugfixes and Enhanced Characters and Cam
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved issues with dashing.
[*] Fixed the broken load game.
[/list]

[h1]Character Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked the existing characters.
[*] Adding arms.
[/list]

[h1]Visual and Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Made the scene brighter.
[*] Proper gun placement on character and correct moving arms when aiming in different directions.
[*] Improved the gun visuals including recoil, shell ejection port, and more.
[*] Added some lines the agent says when he does some cool and fluid action.
[*] Smoother camera and closer to the agent.
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] No changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Working hard for a public Demo
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved issues with the back button during [b]fullscreen toggling[/b].
[*] Fixed HUD problems after switching to fullscreen.
[*] Corrected a [b]144Hz[/b] issue affecting the walk cycle (still some issues left).
[*] Fixed the aim mechanic (still needs more tweaking but it is more precise now).
[/list]

[h1]Character Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Made the agent slightly [b]thinner[/b] for a more human-like walking appearance.
[*] Experimented with longer legs for aesthetic purposes.
[/list]

[h1]Visual and Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the color palette to make the enemies and threads [b]more visible[/b].
[*] Improved aiming, [b]screen shakes[/b], and [b]rumble[/b] effects.
[*] Fine-tuned animations for smoother movement.
[*] Added muzzle flashes, explosions, and other [b]visual enhancements[/b].
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Increased[/b] the [b]difficulty[/b] of the new rooms after the boss room.
[*] Added and adjusted elements for room decoration.
[*] Tweaked [b]enemy behavior[/b] and ammunition drop rates.
[/list]
